mobile: 390 and 320 px, narrow viewport with mouse

results.name: Primary navigation
results.steps: Open all five navigation views. Use Explore portfolio from Overview.
results.expected: Each action exposes one matching section and title.
results.observed: All five views opened and the Overview call to action opened Portfolio.

results.name: Account total and timestamp
results.steps: Open Overview. Compare the displayed total, cash and invested assets. Inspect the summary for an as-of date.
results.expected: Components sum to the total and the snapshot has an as-of date.
results.observed: Cash and invested assets reconcile to $48,260.50. The fixed snapshot is dated 2026-11-07.

results.name: Portfolio return periods
results.steps: Select 6M then 1Y in Portfolio.
results.expected: Each selection updates the return label and amount.
results.observed: Illustrative return over 6 months / +$2,514.35 (+5.49%); Illustrative return over 1 year / +$3,126.40 (+6.93%)

results.name: Portfolio trend by period
results.steps: In Portfolio, inspect the content after selecting 1Y.
results.expected: The Portfolio view includes a period-specific trend.
results.observed: Three distinct chart series matched the labeled endpoint and table for each period.

results.name: Catalog search
results.steps: Search for spaced lowercase crwn, then Delta Growth, then zzzz.
results.expected: Ticker and name match; unmatched query shows an empty state.
results.observed: Ticker, name and no-results checks returned the expected content.

results.name: Watchlist add and remove
results.steps: Save DLTA twice from Research. Open Watchlist, remove DLTA, then open Overview.
results.expected: Only one DLTA entry is added; removal restores the saved count.
results.observed: DLTA appeared once, was removed, and Overview returned to two saved securities.

results.name: Watchlist session disclosure
results.steps: Add DLTA, reload, and open Watchlist.
results.expected: Reload resets the session-only watchlist.
results.observed: Reload restored the two default saved instruments.

results.name: Valid order review
results.steps: Select BRVO, enter quantity 3 and confirm.
results.expected: Total is $613.32 and confirmation states no real order was placed.
results.observed: Demo review complete. No real order was placed. You reviewed 3 shares of BRVO with a simulated total of $613.32.

results.name: Quantity and buying power guards
results.steps: Select CRWN. Confirm quantities 0, 1.5, 101, and 11.
results.expected: Invalid quantities and the over-budget order show distinct messages.
results.observed: Blank, zero, negative, fractional and out-of-range quantities were rejected; 11 CRWN triggered the buying-power warning.

results.name: Confirmation freshness
results.steps: Confirm 2 ALFA, then edit quantity to 3 without confirming again.
results.expected: The prior confirmation clears or is marked stale.
results.observed: Quantity and security edits both cleared confirmation. The revised totals were $375.00 and $613.32.

results.name: Keyboard navigation and focus
results.steps: Reload; Tab through five primary controls, then press Enter on Order review. Tab through the order form.
results.expected: Focus stays visible and all order controls are keyboard reachable.
results.observed: Skip link, five navigation buttons, heading focus, and three order controls checked. {"focus":[["Overview","solid","3px"],["Portfolio","solid","3px"],["Watchlist","solid","3px"],["Research","solid","3px"],["Order review","solid","3px"]],"form":[["ticker","solid","3px"],["quantity","solid","3px"],["simulate","solid","3px"]]}

results.name: Programmatic form labels
results.steps: Find both order controls and the research input by their accessible names.
results.expected: Demo security, Quantity and Search securities each resolve once.
results.observed: Found three matching labels through browser locators.

results.name: Selected state semantics
results.steps: Open Portfolio and select 6M; inspect selected navigation and timeframe controls.
results.expected: Selected state is exposed through an ARIA attribute.
results.observed: Portfolio exposed aria-current=page and 6M exposed aria-pressed=true.

results.name: Focus after saving
results.steps: In Research, Tab from DLTA search to Save, then press Enter.
results.expected: Focus stays on the saved row or moves to a named relevant element.
results.observed: Focus stayed on the same DLTA button and its pressed state updated.

results.name: Watchlist empty state
results.steps: Reload, open Watchlist and remove ALFA and BRVO. Activate Discover demo securities.
results.expected: An empty-state prompt appears and the call to action opens Research.
results.observed: Empty state appeared and the discovery button opened Research.

results.name: Holdings reconcile
results.steps: Open Portfolio and compare three holding values with the Overview invested total.
results.expected: Holding market values sum to $44,060.50.
results.observed: Three holding values sum to $44,060.50.

results.name: Skip link and reverse focus
results.steps: Reload, activate the first link with Enter, then Shift+Tab.
results.expected: Skip moves focus to the page heading and reverse traversal reaches primary navigation.
results.observed: Skip focused the heading, then Shift+Tab returned to primary navigation.

results.name: Focus after removing saved securities
results.steps: Remove ALFA and BRVO using Enter.
results.expected: Focus moves to the next remove control and then the discovery action.
results.observed: Focus moved to Remove BRVO and then Discover demo securities.

results.name: Axe WCAG A and AA rule scan
results.steps: Inspect axe output on all five visible views.
results.expected: No violations among the selected automated checks.
results.observed: No violations reported by the selected automated rules on the five scanned views.

results.name: Form error association
results.steps: Submit an empty quantity, then correct it.
results.expected: The input is marked invalid and linked to the error, then both states clear on edit.
results.observed: Invalid state and associated feedback cleared after correction.

results.name: Sampled Overview gradient contrast
results.steps: Read computed foreground and gradient endpoint colors in Overview. Compare each foreground with the lighter endpoint.
results.expected: Both sampled foregrounds meet 4.5:1 against the lighter gradient endpoint.
results.observed: Computed sample ratios were 7.58:1 and 5.27:1 against the lighter gradient endpoint.

results.name: Mobile layout and order review
results.steps: At 390 x 844, open all views and check horizontal overflow. Complete a demo order at that viewport.
results.expected: Each view fits the viewport and the order interaction completes.
results.observed: Five viewport and document widths: [[390,390],[390,390],[390,390],[390,390],[390,390]]. Demo review complete. No real order was placed. You reviewed 2 shares of ALFA with a simulated total of $250.00.

results.name: Narrow navigation and target sizes
results.steps: At 320 px, inspect all navigation controls and open Portfolio.
results.expected: Navigation fits, visible controls are at least 24 px in both dimensions, and no page overflow occurs.
results.observed: All five navigation controls fit within 320 px and met the tested size. Portfolio did not overflow.
